channel.title: PorTalistic
channel.description: Updates to PorTalistic. Read by the app when it opens; written by Scripts/release.sh, newest first.

item.title: PorTalistic 0.6.22
item.description:
## What's new in 0.6.22
- **Wine 11.16 (DXMT) is now the default for every game.** The Mythic Engine (Wine 7.7) is only the fallback when a game can't run on it. Games already set up on the Engine move over automatically; PorTalistic downloads the build if it isn't there yet. - **PorTalistic notices a Wine build with no container** — when it opens, and right after you delete one — and offers to set it up. Previously it only looked at the build each game would pick, which was usually the Engine, so it never asked about Wine 11.16. - Setting up a container at that prompt shows progress in the sidebar; if it fails, you're told why, with Show Log. - New containers default to the newest Wine build in the Containers "+" sheet.

item.title: PorTalistic 0.6.21
item.description:
## What's new in 0.6.21
- **PorTalistic offers to set up a Wine container when it opens**, if the Wine build your games run on doesn't have one yet — so the first Play doesn't spend a minute building it. Choose Not Now and it's made the first time you press Play, as before. - **The update check tries again** a minute later if the first attempt fails, for example when the app opens before the network is back. - **The update prompt fits on screen.** Release notes wrap instead of stretching the window to their longest line. - The version you have is shown in full — "0.6.20 (74)", not "0.6+74".

item.title: PorTalistic 0.6.20
item.description:
## What's new in 0.6.20
- **Games that need Wine 11.16 start on any Mac.** Setting up its container failed with "Wine stopped before its Windows environment was ready" even though Wine had finished: PorTalistic waited for a message newer Wine no longer prints, then removed the container. - **When a container can't be set up, you're told why**, and **Show Log** opens the details in Finder. - **Check for Updates…** is in Settings ▸ General. - **Wine 11 games start a little faster:** their Windows version is no longer set again before every launch. - The Home page shows the PorTalistic banner until you've played something.

item.title: PorTalistic 0.6.1
item.description:
## What's new in 0.6.1
- **Updates arrive by themselves.** PorTalistic checks when it opens and asks before installing anything. Choose Later and it waits. - **Wine builds download as soon as a game needs them**, with progress at the bottom of the sidebar — no more waiting until you press Play. - **Wine 11.16 (DXMT) is now the first choice**, for Direct3D 11 games and for 32-bit games such as BioShock Remastered. - Fixed a game failing to start when it was launched while its Wine build was still downloading.
